title: schoenorchis subulata
intro: Schoenorchis subulata, commonly known as the "Forked Orchid", is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family (Orchidaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its health benefits, which include treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of Schoenorchis subulata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
